lincs-l1000-cp.sourceNote: LINCS L1000 chemical perturbations (pruned, top 250 by CD coefficient). 156,926 signatures.

lincs-l1000-xpr.sourceNote: L2S2/SigCom LINCS CRISPR knockouts. 65,672 signatures from LINCS L1000 experiments.

tahoe-100m.sourceNote: Tahoe Bio Tahoe-100M dataset. 379 drugs across 72 cell lines with concentration data.

microarrays-cmap.sourceNote: Connectivity Map Build 02 (Lamb et al. 2006). Reprocessed from Harmonizome with full experimental metadata. 1,309 drugs across 5 cell lines.

unknownTerms.note: ~12% of compounds are from Novartis internal screening library. If perturbation is empty, display nsn (e.g., AF-80-QK39) instead and hide PubChem link.

deepcover-moa.sourceNote: Proteome-wide atlas of drug mechanism of action. Mitchell et al., Nature Biotechnology 2023. PMID:36593396. Raw data: MassIVE MSV000089282.

creeds-chem.sourceNote: CREEDS drug perturbation signatures (Wang et al. 2016) combined with Harmonizome GEO microarray signatures not in CREEDS.

rummageo-chem.sourceNote: Automatically mined drug perturbation signatures from GEO RNA-seq. Marino et al. 2024 Patterns.

perturb-atlas-human.sourceNote: Gene expression profiles following genetic perturbation (KD/KO/OE/Mut). Zhang et al. 2024 Nucleic Acids Res. Reprocessed from Harmonizome.

perturb-atlas-mouse.sourceNote: Mouse gene expression profiles following genetic perturbation (KD/KO/OE/Mut). Zhang et al. 2024 Nucleic Acids Res. Reprocessed from Harmonizome.

creeds-gene.sourceNote: CREEDS gene perturbation signatures (Wang et al. 2016) combined with Harmonizome GEO microarray signatures not in CREEDS.

rummageo-gene.sourceNote: Automatically mined gene perturbation signatures from GEO RNA-seq. Marino et al. 2024 Patterns.

replogle-perturb-seq.sourceNote: CRISPRi Perturb-seq gene expression profiles in K562 and RPE1 cells. Replogle et al., Cell, 2022. Reprocessed from Harmonizome.

cm4ai.sourceNote: Cell Maps for AI gene perturbation signatures.
